trickyParts: The filter is the docs package's own closure (24 first-party directories as <dir>/*, the testdata of the three that have one, the migrations and pmdoc schema those packages embed, go_workspace, ci.yaml and the decision-blocks fixture), not a copy of envoy_go_race's packages/envoy/**. check-ci-filters.sh never fails a filter that is wider than the closure, so the narrowness is a choice the gate does not defend: a later package added to the docs closure is caught, but a pattern left too wide is not.

The gate holds the pinned step name and the run text in ci_job_reads.py to ci.yaml character for character, so removing a package from envoy-go-race's step is three edits that must move together: the step name, the run line and the gate's package list.

The job carries no Bun. A docs test does start a subprocess (deep_delete_test.go:30 runs stacktest.Under, which re-executes the test binary), so the reason is that nothing here runs Bun: envoy-go-race's Bun is pmdoc's, and pmdoc stays there.

packages/contracts/fixtures/decision-blocks/** moved out of envoy_go_race and into envoy_go_race_docs because internal/dispatch/docs/approval_carry_test.go:26 is its only reader under packages/envoy; the RULES entry at ci_job_reads.py:258 keys that read by its source file, so it applies to whichever gate compiles it.
deviations: The plan's acceptance table gives the measured time and both jobs' conclusions to the tester, read from this pull request's own run; this round proves the router change on the router's own programs instead, because an implementer never waits on CI.

No Postgres server exists in this pod: psql is present but initdb, a container runtime and cluster access are not (kubectl -n legion auth can-i create jobs answers 'no'), and the only database URL in the pod is the Oh My Pi session store, which a test harness that creates and drops databases must not touch. So the docs suite was not run green against a database here. The job's Postgres service is proven load-bearing by the skip control above, and the green run is CI's.
